author: casarthakahuja
caption:
#collab A set of twin brothers from India have built an AI company from India, which has reached a valuation of USD 1.5 Bn in a matter of just one year from launch...

And you can use what they have built to literally start a business in one day...

Quite like fifteen years ago, a lot of people were building and selling websites for Rs 50,000 each to business owners and making money...

Today, people are using AI to build custom software for business owners and selling it to them as a one time tool or subscription to make money...

The twins are Mukund and Madhav Jha, who have built Emergent, which helps people prompt and build apps and software tools... The company has just closed a Series C of USD 130 Mn and reached a valuation of USD 1.5 Bn

While business owners can use this themselves to build tools like for accounts reconciliation, CRM, payment reminders or attendance management...

But at times they are happy to appoint a freelancer to do it...

Quite like how Wordpress allowed a lot of people to become web designers
Shopify allowed a lot of freelancers to set up ecommerce stores for brands

Now as an individual, if you can build tools using Emergent, you can literally sell them to small and medium businesses as custom software to solve their specific problems...

They also have a full directory of apps that you can easily modify for a client and sell it to them as a business tool.

We will for sure see a lot of custom software designers now flood the market, but early adopters will make more money than the others.
